name: io.github.logisky/logisheets-mcp
title: LogiSheets
description: A real, Excel-compatible spreadsheet engine an agent can compute in and remember in, with a genuine .xlsx out. Deterministic formulas instead of arithmetic the model guessed at, and named blocks addressed by (block, row key, field) so structure survives the agent's own edits.

environmentVariables.name: LOGISHEETS_MCP_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Tool surface: 'core' (default, 17 tools) or 'full', which adds formatting, comments, links, undo/redo and raw structure operations.
